<br>

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    %% External Entities
    WebClient[Web Users / API Clients]
    KafkaClient[External Kafka Clients]

    subgraph AWS[AWS Cloud]
        ALB[AWS Application Load Balancer<br>HTTP / HTTPS]
        NLB[AWS Network Load Balancer<br>TCP / SSL Passthrough]
    end

    subgraph EKS[EKS Cluster]
        
        subgraph ManagerGroup[EEM Manager]
            IngressUI["Ingress: Manager (Console)"]
            IngressAPI[Ingress: Server]
            IngressAdmin[Ingress: Admin]
            IngressAuth[Ingress: Gateway]
            MgrPods((Manager Pod))
            
            IngressUI --> MgrPods
            IngressAPI --> MgrPods
            IngressAdmin --> MgrPods
            IngressAuth --> MgrPods
        end

        subgraph GatewayGrp[Gateway Group]
            GwService[Service: LoadBalancer]
            GwIngress[Ingress: Gateway<br>Ignored Path]
            GwPods((Gateway Pod))
            
            GwService --> GwPods
            GwIngress -.->|Ignored| GwPods
        end
        
        Kafka[(Internal Kafka Brokers)]
    end

    %% Client Routing to Load Balancers
    WebClient -->|HTTPS| ALB
    KafkaClient -->|Kafka Protocol / mTLS| NLB

    %% Load Balancer Routing to Kubernetes Resources
    ALB --> IngressUI
    ALB --> IngressAPI
    ALB --> IngressAdmin
    ALB --> IngressAuth
    
    %% The generated but unused path
    ALB -.->|Unused / Bypassed| GwIngress

    %% NLB Routing
    NLB -->|SSL Passthrough| GwService

    %% Internal Gateway to Kafka Routing
    GwPods -->|TCP| Kafka
    
    %% Styling for ignored components
    classDef ignored stroke-dasharray: 5 5, fill:#eee, color:#999, stroke:#999;
    class GwIngress ignored;
```
